input_eligibility.gse289173: The sealed source provides snRNA-derived states and QTL outcomes, not a topology-matched observed ATAC profile under the current manifest. Native EpiBERT therefore has no sealed inference fixture unless an independently frozen, outcome-blind ATAC context is added before selection lock.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Same-nucleus ATAC is available for development, but its use makes EpiBERT an observed-ATAC comparator. It cannot be called RNA-conditioned and every scored ATAC region must be masked from the input.
input_eligibility.motif_context: A motif vector computed from the same held-donor ATAC peaks is another observed held-donor input. Its construction must occur inside folds and be made available to matched baselines.

interpretation: The released archive predates GSE289173 public availability by nearly two months, so its donor, cell-state, eQTL and ieQTL labels are unexposed. This exposure finding does not make EpiBERT eligible for the sealed task: native inference requires observed context-specific ATAC and a motif vector, which are not part of the current GSE289173 sealed feature contract. Genomic overlap also remains and requires held LD/chromosome blocks with a full-window buffer.

license_disposition.open_champion_eligibility: provisionally eligible after archive notice, exact-member, input-fixture and runtime gates
